newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso may trade around 29 to the dlr.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso may trade around 29 to the dlr.

text.p: The Philippine peso may trade around 29 pesos on Thursday as banks continue to be cautious after its de facto devaluation last Friday, traders said.
The peso, however, is not likely to weaken to the 30-peso record level since the central bank had been selling dollars at 29 in recent days, they said.
One foreign bank dealer said the peso may even gain more strength and trade below 29.
"Many sellers have now come out in the parallel market. The market psychology is that the peso had already reached its limit at 30," the dealer said.
"Importers don't want to buy the dollar at 30. They're willing to wait it out. And banks with dollars to sell see there are no takers," another said.
The peso had been volatile after the central bank announced on Friday it would loosen its grip to end months of speculation.
The central bank late on Wednesday cut its overnight borrowing to 28 percent from 32 percent.
